summary: NetClass Technology Inc filed a Form 6-K disclosing a Joint Venture Formation Agreement dated October 1, 2026 with Xiangdong Wang and Future Science and Education Development Foundation Limited to establish Linkee AI Company Limited, incorporated in Hong Kong on October 5, 2026. Initial capital is HKD 10,000, split 49% Wang, 40% NetClass, 11% Foundation; NetClass contributes HKD 4,000. Initial directors are Wang and CEO Jianbiao Dai. The JV targets overseas sales, marketing and operations for AI companion smart toys; further investment requires separate written agreement. Watch execution risk and any related-party dynamics with the CEO-director overlap.
